why: shrines-v4 without the self-inflicted wound. That branch added three Shrines and paid for one of them with Talisman of Dominance -- a MANA ROCK -- while raising the curve from 2.67 to 2.79. Cutting acceleration to add five-drops is the error, not the Shrines: it measured -0.068 on kill-by-t8 with the interval excluding zero. This keeps all three rocks and adds two Shrines instead of three. Same thesis as v4: under this commander POWER IS MANA VALUE, so Honden of Seeing Winds is a 5/5 and Go-Shintai of Shared Purpose is already an enchantment creature that takes the grant natively. The Shrine COUNT is still not claimed as an argument.
